children: GEE Group postponed its 2026 virtual Annual Meeting to Sept. 30 to allow more time to solicit proxies.
Annual Meeting moved from Sept. 24 to Sept. 30, 2026 and will remain virtual at https://www.cstproxy.com/geegroup/2026.
Postponement intended to provide additional time to solicit proxies for proposals in the Proxy Statement.
Record date for voting remains close of business on Aug. 10, 2026; previously submitted proxies remain valid.
No other items in the Proxy Statement were modified, amended or affected by the supplement.
